描述_EN: the ensemble was doubled in orange-yellow satin. the mantle of the four officers who administered the order-chancellor, provost master of ceremonies, grand treasurer, clerk-secretary-was similar to that of the knights except that it was not embroidered with the order's collar all around. black silk velvet, embroidered with gold and silver: flame pattern all over. upper part hidden by a large collar or mantelet (or epitoge) of green silver cloth (or green velvet?) embroidered with the same motifs.
描述_ZN: 的合奏是用橙黄色的缎子加倍的。 管理骑士团的四位官员--大法官、司仪长、大司库、书记员--的斗篷与骑士团的斗篷相似，只是没有在四周绣上骑士团的领子。 黑色丝绒，绣有金色和银色的图案：全身都是火焰图案。 上半部分被一个绣有相同图案的绿色银布（或绿色天鹅绒）的大项圈或曼特莱（或表记）所掩盖。
